The Assistant Commissioner of Police, Yeshwanthapura Sub-Division, Bangalore, has submitted
charge sheet against the accused persons for the offences punishable U/s.498A and 304B of Ipc and
Sec.3 and
4 of DP Act in Crime No.128/2016 of Yeshwanthapura P.S., Bangalore 2

. The factual matrix of the case is that:
The marriage of deceased-Smt. J. V. Manjula was solemnized with the accused No.1 on 9.2.2014 as per the customs and rites prevails in their community at Chinthamani,
and at the time of marriage the accused No.1 on demand received cash of Rs.3,00,000/- gold ring and bracelet, Rs.30,000/- cash for cloths as dowry from the parents of complainant.

After the marriage the deceased-Smt. Manjula started to reside along with family members of accused No.1 at house bearing No.103/104 situated at 4th Cross, Brindavanagara, Mathikere, within the limits of Yeshwanthapura P.S., Bangalore,

The accused No.1 to 6 with common intention subjected deceased-Smt. Manjula to physical and mental cruelty in demanding additional dowry by resisting her to work and demanding her ATM Card by abusing and assaulting, and forcing her to leave the matrimonial house.
Unable to tolerate the harassment and ill-treatment of accused persons, on 20.03.2016 in between 6.30 p.m. and 8.50 p.m. the deceased committed suicide by hanging at her matrimonial house.

The accused persons have abetted the deceased to commit suicide and hence,
the accused persons have committed the offences as alleged.

3. The concerned police have submitted charge sheet before the jurisdictional XXIV Addl., CMM.,
Bangalore.

sentences.text: at Chinthamani Kyvara Thathaiah Choultry, one Srirama Reddy was mediator and introduced the accused persons.
After marriage Manjula was residing with the accused persons.
She continued her job as Lecturer ever after the marriage.
The accused No.1 was working in a Private Firm.
The accused persons did not demand for dowry either at the time of marriage or after the marriage.
However, gold ornaments were given to deceased- Smt. Manjula at the time of marriage out of love and affection.
Manjula and accused No.1 blessed with male child.
On 20.03.2016, his mother through phone informed that Manjula locked the door of the room and she has not opened the door in spite of request.
He immediately rushed to the house of the accused persons and found that the room of the deceased-Smt. Manjula was locked from inside.
Her mobile was ringing.
Then he saw inside the room through window, and found that Smt. Manjula was in hanging position.
He rushed to the Police Station and informed the police in this regard.
On request of the police he gave a complaint marked as Ex.P1.
Later door was break opened and body of the deceased-Smt. Manjula was removed, Ex.P2 mahazar was drawn in the place of occurrence.
Photographs of place of occurrence produced and marked as Ex.P3 to P9.
Photographs of the marriage and marriage invitation marked as Ex.P10 to P16.
He does not know the contents of Ex.P1 complaint and Ex.P2 Mahazar.
During cross- examination by the learned Special Public Prosecutor PW.1 denies that he signed Ex.P1 and P2 documents after going through the contents.
He denies further statement given to the police marked as Ex.P17.
According to him deceased-Smt. Manjula was leading happy married life with accused persons, her child is presently under the guardianship of accused No.5 and No.6.
Matrimonial dispute between the deceased-Smt. Manjula and the accused No.1, dowry harassment to deceased after the marriage or demand of dowry by the accused persons has not been spoken by PW.1.
PW.1 is not aware as to why Smt. Manjula committed suicide.

12.PW.2 Smt. Rathnamma, the mother of the deceased turned hostile and not supported the case of prosecution regarding alleged demand of dowry, payment of cash and gold ornaments at the time of marriage, mental and physical harassment meted out by the deceased after the marriage.

Though PW.2 deposed regarding the marriage solemnized between the accused No.1 and deceased-Smt.
Manjula, she denies the physical and mental torture meted out by the deceased, resulted in suicidal death of her daughter.

She denies the statement given before police marked as Ex.P18 and P19.
13.PW.3 Krishnamurthy, brother of the deceased-Smt. Manjula deposed that the marriage of accused No.1 was solemnized with the deceased-Smt. Manjula on 9.2.2014 at Chinthamani.
Dceased was working as lecturer, even after marriage.
The accused never demanded for ornaments or dowry either at the time of marriage or after the marriage.
On 20.03.2016 his mother received telephone call that deceased- Smt. Manjula locked the door of her room and inspite of attempt made to open the door, she has not opened the door.
Therefore, PW.1 rushed to the house of the accused persons and found that Smt. Manjula committed suicide.
He denies statement given before the police marked as Ex.P20 and P21.
Dowry harassment meted by deceased-Smt. Manjula resulted in suicidal death has not been spoken by PW.3.
14.PW.4 Smt. Lakshminarasamma, being the inquest mahazar witness turned hostile and not supported the case of the prosecution regarding drawing Ex.P23 mahazar.
However she admits that she went to Victoria Hospital to see the dead body and put her signature, on Ex.P23 inquest mahazar.

sentences.text: Seshadri and PW.6 Raghavendra are being the spot mahazar witnesses turned hostile and not supported the case of the prosecution regarding drawing of Ex.P2 mahazar and seizure of material objects that is the veil piece used for committing suicide.
Nothing has been elicited from the mouth of PW.5 and PW.6 to establish the contents of Ex.P2 mahazar.

16.PW.7 Ravikumar and PW.8 Subbarayappa being the family friends of informant deposed that the marriage of deceased-Smt. Manjula was solemnized on 9.2.2014 with accused at Chintamani Kyvara Thathaiah choultry, the accused was working at Private firm, the deceased-Smt. Manjula was working as Lecturer before marriage and after marriage.
The matrimonial relationship between the accused No.1 and deceased was cordial, they blessed with male child.
They are not aware about reasons for suicidal death of Smt. Manjula.

Both PW.7 and PW.8 treated as hostile witnesses, and cross- examined them by the learned public prosecutor, but nothing has been elicited even during cross-examination to establish the alleged offences committed by the accused persons.

Statements marked as Ex.P24 and P25 respectively denied by PW.7 and PW.8.
17.PW.9 Ashok, Assistant Commissioner of Police, Yeshwanthapura Sub-Division, took further investigation, and filed charge sheet against the accused persons for the alleged offences.
The parents as well as blood relatives of the deceased not deposed anything about the alleged offences committed by the accused persons.

Physical and mental harassment meted out by the deceased resulted in her suicide and receiving of dowry at the time of marriage, demand for additional dowry and gold articles after marriage has not been established by the prosecution with available evidence on record.
The very father and mother of deceased deposed that stomach pain of her daughter was the route cause for suicide of deceased-Smt. Manjula.
Therefore, the prosecution has failed to establish the charges leveled against the accused persons beyond all reasonable doubt.

Accordingly,
I answer points No.1 to 4 in the Negative.
18. Point No.5:

In view of answer of court on points No.1 to 4, this court pass the following:-
ORDER Acting U/s.235(1) of Cr.P.C., the accused No.1 to 6 are hereby acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.498A and 304B r/w Sec.149 of Indian Penal Code and Sec.3 and 4 of DP Act.
The bail and surety bonds of accused No.1 to 6 stand canceled.
